name: Parkson Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年公司公告主要为季度业绩、提供财务援助及续延关联方交易授权等常规事项，未披露业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或出售。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比-12.8%，净利润同比-245.9%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements mainly covered quarterly results, provision of financial assistance and renewal of the shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions, with no disclosed expansion, new business, reduction or disposal of business segments. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue fell 12.8% YoY and net profit fell 245.9% YoY.

segments.name: 集团

segments.note_en: This year's announcements covered provision of financial assistance and renewal of the shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions, with no segment-specific updates disclosed.
